# Vendored Browser Dependencies

These files are copied beside the generated Demo viewer so the page works
without network access.

| File | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three.min.js` | Three.js `0.160.0` | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js` | MIT |
| `lucide.min.js` | Lucide `0.468.0` | `https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js` | ISC |

The upstream license headers are retained in the minified files.
